== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Eli Vanto In Dreadnaught]]: the PC card image of [[Eli Vanto In Dreadnaught]] (21 July 2024, [[:File:V23-D-elivantoindreadnaught.gif|V23-D-elivantoindreadnaught.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (page 3). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
